s: Tarakah: "bassukkot teshebu shibat yamim [go'], lemaan yedeu dorotekem ki bassukkot hoshabti et bene yisrael behotzii otam meeretz mitzrayim" — hem hayu anene kebodo shehiqqipam bahem letzel lebal yakkeh bahem sharab vashemesh. Vedugma lazeh tzivvanu laasot sukkot haasuyot letzel, kede shennazkir nipleotayv venoreotayv. Velaken tzarik kol adam lekavven bishibato bassukka, sheyyosheb bah kede leqayyem mitzvat haqqadosh baruk hu shetztzivvanu lesheb bassukka zeker litziat mitzrayim. Umitzva letaqqen hassukka velibnotah kullah miyyad lemochorat yom hakkippurim achar yetzia mibbet hakkeneset, mitzva habbaa leyado al yachmitzenna:
